visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-button: Label for the button to open the EduSharing dialog in the VisualEditor toolbar. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-title: Title of the dialog for inserting EduSharing media. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-help-tit: Title for the help section in the EduSharing dialog. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-select: Label for the button to select an object from the EduSharing repository. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-change: Label for the button to change the selected object in the EduSharing dialog. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-options: Label for the tab with advanced options in the EduSharing dialog. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-action: Label for the action field in the EduSharing dialog. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-id: Label for the ID field in the EduSharing dialog. The ID is a unique identifier for the object in the EduSharing repository. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-caption: Label for the caption field in the EduSharing dialog. The caption is a description of the media object. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-mimetype: Label for the MIME type field in the EduSharing dialog. The MIME type describes the format of the media object. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-version: Label for the version field in the EduSharing dialog. The version indicates the version of the media object. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-repotype: Label for the repository type field in the EduSharing dialog. The repository type indicates the type of the repository where the object is stored. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-versions: Label for the field to select which version of the object to display. {{desc}}
Option to always display the latest version of the object. {{desc}}
Option to display the current version of the object. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-size: Label for the width field in the EduSharing dialog. The width is the display width of the media object. {{desc}}
visualeditor-mwedusharingdialog-align: Label for the alignment field in the EduSharing dialog. The alignment determines how the media object is aligned in the text. {{desc}}
edusharing-placeholder-unavailable: Message shown when the edu-sharing repository is unavailable. {{desc}}
edusharing-missing-keys-hint: Hint shown when no edu-sharing keys are found. Instructs the user to run a maintenance script to generate keys and register the installation. {{desc}}
edusharing-signature-invalid-hint: Hint shown when the signature verification fails. Asks the user to verify if the EduSharing extension is registered at the repository with the current keys. {{desc}}
edusharing-popup-blocked: Error shown when the browser's pop-up blocker prevented the repository picker window from opening.
edusharing-ticket-failed: Error shown when no repository ticket could be obtained for the current user.
apierror-edusharing-unavailable:
API error. Parameters:
* $1 - reason reported by the repository connection
apierror-edusharing-noticket: API error shown when the repository refused to issue a ticket.
